# Streamlabs Desktop triggers

## Connected

Runs when Cuebot connects to Streamlabs Desktop.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%sd.name%` | The name of the connection |
| `%sd.host%` | The computer Streamlabs Desktop runs on |

<small>Type id: `slobs.connected`</small>

## Disconnected

Runs when Cuebot loses its connection to Streamlabs Desktop, for example when you close it.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%reason%` | Why the connection ended |
| `%sd.name%` | The name of the connection |

<small>Type id: `slobs.disconnected`</small>

## Recording started

Runs when Streamlabs Desktop starts recording.

<small>Type id: `slobs.recordStarted`</small>

## Recording stopped

Runs when Streamlabs Desktop stops recording.

<small>Type id: `slobs.recordStopped`</small>

## Replay buffer saved

Runs when Streamlabs Desktop saves a replay clip (the last moments of your stream).

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%savedReplayPath%` | Where the replay file was saved |

<small>Type id: `slobs.replayBufferSaved`</small>

## Scene changed

Runs when Streamlabs Desktop switches to another scene.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Scene** | Only react to this scene, typed exactly as Streamlabs Desktop shows it. Leave empty for any scene. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%sceneName%` | The scene it switched to |
| `%previousScene%` | The scene it was on before |
| `%sceneId%` | Streamlabs's id for the new scene |

<small>Type id: `slobs.sceneChanged`</small>

## Streaming started

Runs when Streamlabs Desktop starts streaming. Good for a "going live" message.

<small>Type id: `slobs.streamStarted`</small>

## Streaming stopped

Runs when Streamlabs Desktop stops streaming.

<small>Type id: `slobs.streamStopped`</small>
